Gamers are constantly looking for ways to clear their schedules for the anticipated launch. Now, according to a report by IGN Games, players in a specific region might just have found the ultimate trick.

Recent reports highlight a unique legal loophole in Germany that reportedly lets 60 employees take time off work to play *GTA 6* when it launches, and crucially, without putting their jobs in jeopardy. For hardcore fans who have been waiting over a decade for the next chapter of the franchise, the idea of using a legal mechanism to secure uninterrupted gaming time sounds like a dream come true.

The specific details surrounding how this loophole functions, the exact criteria required to qualify among the lucky 60, and whether the time off guarantees pay or simply job protection remain restricted based on the available source material.

While the prospect of dodging workplace consequences to explore the next evolution of open-world gaming is thrilling, players should remain grounded.
